public_rationale: TheAgentCompany evaluation, available December 18, 2024, reports that agents failed most simulated workplace tasks [e5]. SHRM reported on May 12, 2025 that IBM's CEO described AI replacing HR workers while total employment increased; the timing of the reductions was unspecified [e6]. Neither item establishes whether capability shortfalls materially limited worker replacement in May 2025 or measures capabilities against identifiable assertions by Amodei and Altman [e5, e6]. The causal claim remains unresolved [e5, e6].
limitations: The earlier benchmark does not establish the capabilities of systems available in May 2025 or connect its failures to staffing decisions [e5].
The IBM report does not independently establish replacement specifically by generative AI or the extent of economy-wide replacement [e6].
These items do not distinguish capability constraints from cost, deployment time, demand, regulation, or organizational choices, or identify the disputed executive assertions [e5, e6].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI lacks the capabilities Dario Amodei and Sam Altman claim, which is why it is not replacing workers at scale.

statement.excerpt: generative AI does not have the capabilities that people like Dario Amodei and Sam Altman repeatedly act like they do

from_speaker: because generative AI does not have the capabilities
people like Dario Amodei and Sam Altman repeatedly act like they do
our_interpretation: Read the capability claim as concerning reliable performance of substantial workplace duties without a replacement human doing the core work.
Read because as asserting a material explanation for limited replacement, not necessarily its sole cause.
Assess the ongoing causal relationship around May 2025, the latest completed month before the post.
No particular statement by Amodei or Altman is specified; future predictions cannot automatically be treated as claims of present capability.
criteria.support_condition: Workplace evidence links limited replacement materially to demonstrated capability failures and establishes the relevant gap between current capability and the executives' actual assertions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched evidence shows the relevant capability claims were accurate and that limited replacement was explained by other constraints rather than capability shortfalls.

evidence.explanation: The benchmark documents capability limitations in simulated workplace tasks. It concerns earlier systems and does not connect those failures to actual staffing decisions or identify the executives' disputed statements.

The report describes replacement claims alongside hiring elsewhere in IBM. This illustrates why limited net job loss cannot by itself establish insufficient technical capability; it does not resolve the broader causal claim.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Identify the executives' contemporaneous capability assertions and establish the extent of worker replacement in May 2025. Matched capability evaluations and staffing records would need to show either that capability shortfalls materially limited replacement, or that the asserted capabilities were present and other constraints explained limited replacement.
